listing.aiSummary: Provides an English translation for a ship design bureau mod featuring linked fleet combat networks and a merit-based exchange system.

description: Translates the original Chinese mod into English for broader accessibility. Ships in this faction link into a shared combat network, gaining strength as more members are present on the battlefield. Players earn War Merit Tokens by destroying hostile ships, which can be spent at a Forward Outpost for various upgrades or used on a dice board.

discordPostHtml:
Hello this is a full translation for the Tiangong United Ship Design Bureau ready for us English users! 🎉

  • Myriad Machines Linkage Core: Tiangong ships don't fight alone. Fleet members link into a shared combat network, and the more of them on the field, the stronger they all get.
  • The Tiangong United Exchange: Destroy hostile ships to earn War Merit Tokens, then spend them at the Forward Outpost on ships, weapons, colony structures… or test your luck on the dice board.
  • And a few secrets

Requirements

  • LazyLib, MagicLib, GraphicsLib, LunaLib, BoxUtil

Original mod by kickis

if you find anything wrong translation or otherwise plse post the problem here with the starsector.log and and describe what you were doing and ill do my best on my end or communicate with kickis
